title: Early Career Industrial Designer
note: Associate-level industrial design role on bicycles, components and equipment; internship, co-op or academic work counts toward the 1+ year of experience.

facts.duties: Supports concept development and design execution for bikes, components and equipment under experienced designers: sketching, CAD, rendering, prototypes and mockups, design reviews, and keeping design intent through to production.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in Industrial Design or a related field; 1+ year of relevant design experience including internships, co-ops or academic work; strong portfolio; sketching, 2D and 3D tools; an interest in cycling or performance products.
facts.apply: Apply on the Workday posting with a portfolio.
